multi_prompt.prompt: Medium shot, @Element1 steps forward confrontationally toward the produce seller, she points accusingly at the glowing bottles on the shelves behind him and says 'What are those things in the back? I saw them glowing.' Suspicious expression, afternoon market lighting, shallow depth of field
